headword: {月極駐車場|つきぎめちゅうしゃじょう}
reading: つきぎめちゅうしゃじょう
gloss: monthly parking lot; monthly rental parking space

definitions.gloss: monthly rental parking space; reserved monthly parking lot
definitions.explanation: A parking space or lot rented on a monthly basis with a fixed fee, as opposed to coin-operated or hourly parking. Extremely common in Japanese cities.

examples.japanese: {月極駐車場|つきぎめちゅうしゃじょう}を{借|か}りている。
examples.english: I rent a monthly parking space.

examples.japanese: この{辺|あた}りの{月極駐車場|つきぎめちゅうしゃじょう}は{月|つき}{二万円|にまんえん}くらいだ。
examples.english: Monthly parking lots around here cost about 20,000 yen per month.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}したので、{近|ちか}くで{月極駐車場|つきぎめちゅうしゃじょう}を{探|さが}さなければならない。
examples.english: Since I moved, I need to find a monthly parking space nearby.

notes: Compound of {月極|つきぎめ} (monthly basis/fixed monthly) + {駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう} (parking lot). The word {月極|つきぎめ} is a common sight on signs throughout Japan but is often misread as 'げっきょく' by learners; the correct reading is つきぎめ. Contrasts with コインパーキング (coin-operated parking) and {時間貸|じかんが}し{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう} (hourly parking). Monthly parking is essential in Japanese cities where most apartments do not include parking.
